name: merlon-monorepo
description: Merlon Docs: a documentation system for software projects, run by an Agent Skill and a CLI

scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @merlon-docs/merlon-docs-core run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @merlon-docs/merlon-docs-cli run test:coverage
scripts.vale:sync: mkdir -p examples/sample-guides/styles docs/styles && (cd examples/sample-guides && vale sync) && (cd docs && vale sync) && rm -rf docs/styles/MerlonDocs docs/styles/MerlonDocs-PandocId docs/styles/MerlonDocs-Xref examples/sample-guides/styles/MerlonDocs examples/sample-guides/styles/MerlonDocs-PandocId examples/sample-guides/styles/MerlonDocs-Xref && ln -sfn ../../packages/merlon-docs-presets/vale/MerlonDocs docs/styles/MerlonDocs && ln -sfn ../vale-local/MerlonDocs-PandocId docs/styles/MerlonDocs-PandocId && ln -sfn ../../../packages/merlon-docs-presets/vale/MerlonDocs examples/sample-guides/styles/MerlonDocs && ln -sfn ../../../docs/vale-local/MerlonDocs-PandocId examples/sample-guides/styles/MerlonDocs-PandocId
scripts.prepare:docs: pnpm run verify:peers && pnpm run vale:sync
scripts.docs:check:repo: pnpm run docs:lint:changeset-links && node packages/merlon-docs-cli/dist/cli.js check --config docs/merlon.config.json --docs-root docs --require-lint --require-vale
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:check:repo && pnpm run docs:check:examples
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run skill:validate && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.skill:validate: node scripts/lint-skill-frontmatter.mjs && skills-ref validate ./skills/merlon-docs && skills-ref validate ./skills/merlon-docs-arch-oss-library && skills-ref validate ./skills/merlon-docs-arch-product-docs-site && skills-ref validate ./skills/merlon-docs-arch-gtm && skills-ref validate ./skills/merlon-docs-arch-research
scripts.skill:dev: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills add . --skill merlon-docs --agent claude-code cursor --yes
scripts.docs:compile: pnpm run docs:compile:repo && pnpm run docs:compile:examples
scripts.site:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:compile:repo
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run site:prepare && pnpm --filter @merlon-docs/merlon-docs-site run dev
scripts.site:build: pnpm run site:prepare && pnpm --filter @merlon-docs/merlon-docs-site run build:site
